dict.string: ScrumTrace reads the frontmost window title so meeting context can name the app you were presenting.
ScrumTrace reads the frontmost window title so agent context can name the app you were presenting. It does not control the computer.
ScrumTrace records meeting audio so spoken decisions can be transcribed locally and attached to coding-agent context.
ScrumTrace captures system audio from the presentation so agent context includes what was demoed, not only the microphone.
ScrumTrace records the presentation screen to build screenshots and clips for AI coding agents.
